verses.text: Yahweh says, “You people who live on [APO] islands in the ocean,
Who has urged this king to come from the east?
Even though they march through areas where they have not gone previously,
Who has enabled rulers to do [DOU] mighty things like that?
People who live on [PRS] islands in the ocean are afraid while they watch.
They encourage each other and say to each other,
The craftsmen encourage those who make things from gold,
Yahweh says, “You people of Israel are like my servants;
I summoned you from very distant places [DOU] on the earth,
Do not be afraid,
It is certain that all those who are angry with you Israeli people will be disgraced [DOU].
If you search for those who tried to conquer you,
It will be as though I will hold you up by your right hand.
Although you people of Israel [DOU] think that you are as insignificant as worms,
I will cause you to be like [MET] a ◄threshing sledge/big piece of metal that has sharp teeth for separating grain from chaff►.
You will toss them up into the air,
When poor and needy people need water and they have no water,
I will cause rivers to flow for them on the barren hills.
I will plant trees in the desert—
I will do that in order that people who see it will think about it, and they will know and understand [DOU]
I, Yahweh, the true king of Israel say to you nations,
Bring them here to tell us what is going to happen!
Yes, those idols should tell us what will happen in the future.
But that is impossible, because idols are absolutely worthless [HYP];
“But I have incited/urged a ruler who will come with his army from the north.
◄Who told you people long ago that this would happen?/No one told you people long ago that this would happen!► [RHQ]
I was the first one to tell the people of Jerusalem,
None of your idols told you that [DOU].
Think about it: Those idols are all useless, worthless [DOU] things.
